name: cmdproto
description: Proto-first ABI boundary toolkit for strict human and machine command interfaces.

scripts.schema:build: mkdir -p dist && buf build proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o dist/schema.binpb && tsx scripts/validate-schema.ts dist/schema.binpb
scripts.schema:build:greeter: mkdir -p examples/greeter/dist && buf build examples/greeter/proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb && tsx scripts/validate-schema.ts examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb
scripts.check: buf lint && npm run schema:build && npm run schema:build:greeter && npm run build && npm test
